requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} asked for governed drift monitoring on the production forecast. She believes that governed drift checks are essential to catch silent failures before they impact store availability.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} asked for governed drift monitoring on the production forecast.
requirement.reading: She believes that governed drift checks are essential to catch silent failures before they impact store availability.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: You are treating my drift monitoring request as a nice to have feature, but I need governed checks that flag silent forecast failures before stores order blind. Without that governance layer, we are just guessing when the models drift.
output.correction: I did not ask for a new dashboard, I asked for automated alerts that trigger a human review when the forecast deviates from expected patterns. Please stop filing this as a reporting task and start treating it as a reliability gate for the production service.
